QorCap v0.3.39: Madden or Call of Duty at Start Match

`receipt.v0.json` is unchanged.

- [#122](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/122): Start Match asks Madden or Call of Duty before the side prompt. `Start Match.cmd --game madden` or `--game cod` skips the prompt. Omitting `--game` on a direct run stays Madden. Call of Duty loads receipt game `cod_mw4` and profile `cod_mw4_hud`.
- [#123](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/123), [#124](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/124), [#126](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/126), [#127](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/127): hitmarker, the XP plate, killfeed presence, VICTORY, DEFEAT, and scoreboard K/A are calibrated from private practice frames. A thinner Kill Confirmed header is joined, then checked on the same gates. The glitched splash does not agree. A blurred word does not agree.
- [#129](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/129): a word elsewhere in the crop does not agree, and a frame where both words agree is not read.
- [#130](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/130): a Call of Duty final uses the end word together with Qortrola30's own scoreboard row (kills and deaths; assists when that column is on the board). The row is whose match it is. Another player's row is not used. Home and away are not filled from that row.
- QorCap/QorTime’s CoD path is built so a player can leave a correlated match record (controller + video + HUD + scoreboard hooks) that others can check: agreed, Counted, a receipt, a mismatch, or not Counted. No Call of Duty match is claimed as a public verification.
